create_FunnelConfig: create a FunnelConfig instance with custom block_sizes, d_model, and n_head for a Funnel Transformer model
validate_FunnelConfig_architecture: validate a FunnelConfig instance to ensure block_sizes and block_repeats lengths match and pooling_type is valid
read_FunnelConfig_num_hidden_layers: read the num_hidden_layers property from a FunnelConfig to get the sum of block_sizes
read_FunnelConfig_num_blocks: read the num_blocks property from a FunnelConfig to get the number of blocks from block_sizes length
build_FunnelConfig_from_dict: build a FunnelConfig from a dictionary of model hyperparameters using PreTrainedConfig initialization
